_readme: Curated recipe seed, expanded by scripts/import-recipes.mjs. Ingredient `food` names must exactly match a row in the `foods` table (scripts/seed-foods.json). Nutrition (n) is per serving, reasonable-effort estimates in the same spirit as the food seed: [kcal, protein_g, carbs_g, fat_g, fiber_g, sugar_g, sodium_mg].

recipes.name: Paneer & Spinach Curry
recipes.description: A quick North Indian curry — paneer simmered with tomato, onion and spinach.
instructions: Heat ghee in a pan and sauté the onion until golden.
Add the tomato and cook down into a soft base, 5-6 minutes.
Stir in cubed paneer and spinach, simmer 8-10 minutes.
Season to taste and serve hot.

recipes.name: Masala Omelette with Roti
recipes.description: A spiced onion-tomato omelette with whole wheat roti — a classic Indian breakfast.
instructions: Whisk the eggs with finely chopped onion and tomato.
Heat ghee in a pan and pour in the egg mixture.
Cook until set, flipping once. Serve with warm roti.

recipes.name: Chana Masala with Basmati Rice
recipes.description: Spiced chickpeas in a tomato-onion gravy over basmati rice.
instructions: Sauté onion in mustard oil until soft, add tomato and cook to a paste.
Add chickpeas and a splash of water, simmer 15 minutes with your spices of choice.
Serve over basmati rice.

recipes.name: Grilled Chicken & Sweet Potato
recipes.description: A straightforward high-protein plate — grilled chicken, roasted sweet potato, steamed broccoli.
instructions: Grill the chicken breast until cooked through.
Roast the sweet potato and steam the broccoli.
Drizzle everything with olive oil and serve.

recipes.name: Overnight Oats with Berries
recipes.description: Oats soaked in milk and yogurt overnight, topped with berries and honey.
instructions: Stir the oats, milk and yogurt together in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with berries and a drizzle of honey before eating.

recipes.name: Greek Salad with Feta
recipes.description: Cucumber, tomato, bell pepper, olives and feta with olive oil.
instructions: Chop the cucumber, tomato and bell pepper into chunks.
Toss with olives and crumbled feta.
Drizzle with olive oil just before serving.

recipes.name: Baked Salmon with Quinoa
recipes.description: Oven-baked salmon over quinoa with roasted asparagus.
instructions: Bake the salmon at 200°C for 12-15 minutes.
Cook the quinoa and roast the asparagus with a little olive oil.
Plate the salmon over the quinoa with asparagus on the side.

recipes.name: Tofu Stir-fry with Rice
recipes.description: Sesame-fried tofu with broccoli and bell pepper over white rice.
instructions: Press and cube the tofu, then pan-fry in sesame oil until golden.
Add broccoli and bell pepper, stir-fry 5-6 minutes.
Serve over steamed white rice.

recipes.name: Edamame & Miso Bowl
recipes.description: A simple miso-dressed bowl of edamame, bok choy and jasmine rice.
instructions: Steam the edamame and bok choy.
Whisk the miso with a little warm water into a dressing.
Combine everything over jasmine rice.

recipes.name: Falafel & Hummus Plate
recipes.description: Falafel, hummus, pita and fresh vegetables — a Middle Eastern lunch plate.
instructions: Warm the falafel and pita.
Spread the hummus on the plate or inside the pita.
Add sliced cucumber and tomato and serve.

recipes.name: Lamb & Bulgur Bowl
recipes.description: Roasted lamb over bulgur wheat with fennel.
instructions: Roast the lamb to your preferred doneness and rest before slicing.
Toss the bulgur with sliced fennel and olive oil.
Top with the sliced lamb.

recipes.name: Black Bean & Avocado Bowl
recipes.description: A Latin American bowl of black beans, avocado, tortilla and tomato.
instructions: Warm the black beans through.
Char the tortillas lightly and slice into strips.
Assemble the bowl with beans, diced avocado, tomato and tortilla strips.

recipes.name: Grilled Fish Tacos
recipes.description: White fish tacos with cabbage slaw and avocado.
instructions: Grill or pan-sear the fish and flake it.
Warm the tortillas and shred the cabbage.
Assemble tacos with fish, cabbage and diced avocado.
